subject: Post-hire credential escrow & verification request – evidence and sampling plan
messages:
From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@sig.org>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@halcyonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 sample request — post-hire credentials & escrow evidence

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/SOC2 spot review for Halcyon Health (customer), we need to validate your post-hire verification and credential escrow controls for a small sample of employees who onboarded in Q2 2028. Specifically we need: 

- Redacted background check manifests (names redacted but unique IDs retained)
- Q2 training roster showing completion timestamps and training module IDs
- A copy of the credential escrow manifest (what's escrowed, who has access, last rotation date)

Can you confirm you can provide a 25-user sample plus one retained full record for chain-of-custody review by EOD Wed 7/31? If you have a documented sampling methodology or playbook, please include that.

If you prefer, you can route the artifacts to our vendor (bgchecks@hirefast.io) and cc me; they will pull the manifest and perform the initial redaction.

Thanks,
Sara Lewis
SIG Review Lead
SecureAudit Group
[Attachment: SIG-evidence-checklist_v2.pdf]
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@sig.org>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, bgchecks@hirefast.io
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 sample request — post-hire credentials & escrow evidence

Sara — thanks for the checklist. Looping in Kimberly (HR lead) and Jordan (InfoSec/compliance) to coordinate.

Kimberly — can your team produce the 25-user Q2 sample plus one full retained record? We have a credential escrow CSV exported from our key management system; Jordan can confirm the redaction scope.

Quick notes:
- We will provide redacted BG manifests (IDs preserved) and the training roster CSV (module IDs and completion timestamps).
- Credential escrow export contains: username (hashed), escrow_id, secret_type, escrowed_by, last_rotation_iso. We will redact usernames and include a mapping table separately (internal only).
- Proposed delivery: upload to Drive folder (link below) and provide a signed transmittal.

Kim/Kimbers — any known blockers by EOD Wed? If HR needs the vendor to do redaction, we can give them limited access.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, sara.lewis@sig.org
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, bgchecks@hirefast.io
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 sample request — post-hire credentials & escrow evidence

Tessa / Sara — we can assemble this. Internal plan below and asks: 

Plan and timeline
- Today: HR exports training_roster_Q2_2028.csv and BG manifest (full).
- Tue AM: HR will produce redacted BG manifest (redaction per agreed pattern: last 4 of SSN -> X; full name -> token ID).
- Wed 10:00 PDT: Deliver 25-sample bundle + 1 full retained record to Drive; transmittal signed by HR lead.

Requests/Clarifications
1) For the retained full record: we will provide it in a secure, access-restricted folder and require NDA acknowledgement from any external reviewer beyond SIG. Please confirm who will access (Sara or HireFast?).
2) Is the 25-user sample expected to be randomly sampled across hires in Q2, or should we bias for new engineers and customer-facing staff? We propose random stratified sampling (proportionate by role buckets) — attached short sampling methodology.
3) For credential escrow: we will include a CSV manifest and a short redaction guide. Jordan — can you sign off on the redaction pattern for the escrow CSV?

Attachments: training_roster_Q2_2028.csv (stub), bg_check_manifest_full.pdf (internal), sampling_methodology.pdf

Kimberly Park
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, sara.lewis@sig.org
Cc: bgchecks@hirefast.io
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 sample request — post-hire credentials & escrow evidence

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the proposed redaction approach and it aligns with our internal policy (PII removed, unique ID preserved). A couple of operational points before delivery: 

- Access control: the retained full record will only be shared after a signed transmittal and explicit list of reviewers. Sara — please confirm if SIG needs direct access or if HireFast will act as proxy reviewer.
- Credential escrow manifest: we will replace username with hashed_id and include escrow_access_roles column (list of roles with access). We will also add a last_rotation_iso timestamp for each escrowed secret.
- Audit trail: HR will include an MD5 checksum manifest for the CSV files and a short chain-of-custody note (who exported, who redacted, who uploaded). That will satisfy our internal SOC2 control evidence pattern.

If that sounds good, we will upload to the Drive folder and notify Sara and HireFast.

Jordan Blake
Director, InfoSec Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credential_escrow_manifest.csv]
